data.name: Fabil
data.gender_notes: Fabil is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Fabil is derived from the Arabic word 'Fawabil' which means 'morning dew'. It is a beautiful and gentle name that evokes images of the first light of dawn and the freshness of new beginnings. The name Fabil carries the meaning “Morning Dew” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Fabil usually hope their child will grow to embody morning dew and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Fabil represents the spiritual essence of new beginnings and the renewal of life. It is a reminder of the beauty and gentleness of nature and the power of the morning sun to bring light and life to the world.
data.etymology: Fabil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Morning Dew.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fabil total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
